capture_protocol.finding_counts: Copy total and severity counts from the exact-head JSON report after CI completes.
capture_protocol.ci_duration_seconds: Copy verifier and focused-test durations from the GitHub step summary.
capture_protocol.reviewer_effort_minutes: Each reviewer records their active review minutes after completing the assigned review; use UNKNOWN until supplied.
capture_protocol.false_positive_disposition: Record every report finding disposition after review; do not classify an unreviewed finding as false positive.

baseline.limitations: No reviewed pull request has supplied these baseline measurements yet.
